pr_body:
Suggest the new flag instead of crashing when `--override_repository` is applied to a non-existent repo with `--noenable_workspace`.

Fixes #22691 

RELNOTES: The new `--inject_repository` flag can be used to add new repositories via the CLI with `--enable_bzlmod`. Such repositories behave as if they were declared by `local_repository` via `use_repo_rule` in the root module.
pr_title: Add `--inject_repository` and fix crash on overridden non-existent repo
pr_comment: There are a number of test failures referencing files under `bazel-genfiles` and I don't really know how those have been passing so far. I don't see `--noincompatible_merge_genfiles_directory` in any of the tests.

review_comment: does this matter at all? just checking. If not, I have a slight preference for not setting it for least surprise, but not a big deal.

The value doesn't matter as far as I can tell, but we need to set one or the builder throws. `true` seems more fitting to me than `false` since `--inject_repository` repos won't be available to consumers of the root module.
